name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist in the Beacon module's distance is immediately below Okafor.
Okafor's distance is immediately below the colonist in the Forge module.
The colonist in the Forge module's distance is at least 4 ly more than Bauer.
